unit_of_analysis.species: every species satisfying the frozen >=2 distinct 90s-positive-node rule
unit_of_analysis.witness: every 2023 positive physical node for each eligible species
unit_of_analysis.world: all 35 frozen A/M worlds; no world may be dropped by post-response preference

primary_denominators: all eligible species with >=1 heldout positive witness
all heldout positive physical-node witnesses across eligible species
all 35 declared A/M worlds within each eligible species

species_terminal_classes.no_heldout_positive_witness: eligible from 90s calibration but no 2023 positive node; retained in denominator and not treated as support or refutation
species_terminal_classes.heldout_positive_no_contraction: at least one 2023 positive witness but none eliminates a calibration-surviving world
species_terminal_classes.heldout_contracted_survivor_fiber: at least one but not all calibration-surviving worlds eliminated by 2023 positives
species_terminal_classes.heldout_falsified_all_calibration_worlds: 2023 positive evidence eliminates every calibration-surviving world; declared A/M universe is falsified for that species

primary_report: species count in every terminal class
species with any heldout contraction / all eligible species
species with any heldout contraction / species with heldout positives
species with complete universe falsification / all eligible species
species retaining >1 worlds after all positive evidence
median/min/max heldout contraction fraction across eligible species with a nonzero calibration survivor denominator
witness_report: number/fraction of witnesses eliminating all calibration-surviving worlds
distribution of individually eliminated world fractions
A-only, M-only, and joint A+M failure counts summed over frozen world-by-witness comparisons
world_report: for each of 35 world IDs: number of eligible species for which it survives calibration
for each world ID: number of those species in which heldout positives falsify it
for each world ID: final species-survival fraction conditional on calibration survival
do not rank worlds as biologically true; report only compatibility/falsification frequency
interpretation_rules: any contraction is evidence that later positive observations contain information capable of eliminating at least one predeclared ecological world
no contraction is a valid null result and does not justify changing A thresholds or M horizons
complete world-set falsification indicates inadequate declared A/M universe for that species, not failure of the positive witness
persistent multiple survivors after all positives is empirical nonidentification conditional on this A/M universe
axis attribution labels which declared constraint excluded the positive; it is not causal decomposition of the observed population response
species-to-species contraction differences are not a sensitivity ranking
prohibited_post_result_actions: replace primary denominator by only contracting species

manuscript_role.favorable: real positive observations can contract/falsify a frozen finite A/M world set; use as retrospective bridge only
manuscript_role.null: the frozen real A/M world set was not discriminated by heldout positives; retain as informative limit
manuscript_role.universe_falsified: positive evidence rejects the declared real-system world family; use as a falsification example rather than repair
manuscript_role.freshness: none of these outcomes are fresh confirmatory evidence because article-level aggregate results were known before bridge design
